Peaceful stint full minutes
The coordination meeting was held for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Attendees were Hugo Bennett, Yara Wilson, and Harley.

The team reviewed routine handling, with a quick reminder that calm and humane methods must stay standard whenever animals move through the desk. Staff noted that carrier checks, water access, and quiet waiting space need tighter attention so each animal stays settled from check-in through handoff. The welfare coordinator's review was discussed as a practical safeguard, especially when a traveler reports stress signs or special comfort needs.

The group also talked through care planning for different species and temperaments, since one approach will not suit every pet. Updates were shared on clearer handover notes, better tracking of comfort items, and faster flagging of anything that could upset the animal or slow the trip. The tone stayed urgent but steady, with everyone agreeing the desk should keep responses simple, kind, and consistent.

The meeting ended with agreement to keep the current process under close watch and to raise any concern right away.
